$comment: The app's frame: the name, the manifest, the install and upright lines, the update note, the error sheet and the stamps (GAME_DESIGN 18.3, 18.11). Working words; status comes from approved.json.

app.name.ctx: The game's full name: the page title, the manifest, and the name over the cover (split over two lines there)

app.short_name.ctx: Under the Home Screen icon, and anywhere space is tight (iOS cuts labels at about 12 characters)

app.install.text:
Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.
The Home Screen app keeps its own saves.
app.install.ctx: In Safari only, until the game is on the Home Screen (two lines)

app.upright.ctx: When the phone is turned sideways, beside a turn-the-phone glyph

app.offline.ctx: A small stamp, once the game is saved on the phone

app.update.ctx: The update note: the title page until the cabin is built, then the mailbox, when a new version arrives

app.update.restart.ctx: The update note's button: saves the game and reloads into the new version

app.error.line.ctx: The error sheet, if something breaks

app.error.reopen.ctx: Error sheet button: re-renders the screen from the autosave (a reload until S3)

app.preview_name.ctx: Under the preview build's Home Screen icon (iOS cuts labels at about 12 characters)

app.build.ctx: The build stamp: the build code alone, no words (five taps on it open the debug menu)
